FAB307-Cold-Extended Art.reason: the promo is genuinely cold foil and FAB307-RF is its image; cardvault catalogues that face rainbow-foil, which is wrong on their side. Print key stays Cold/Extended Art.

MST000-Rainbow-Back.reason: each of the four printings is on its own face; cardvault types this one MST000-RF_BACK regular while its own front MST000-RF is rainbow-foil and the cold back MST000-CF_BACK is cold-foil, so the finish check can never pass it. Wrong on their side.
